# Excalidraw fixture provenance

`real-export-v2.excalidraw` uses the official Excalidraw v2 scene envelope and the ellipse element
from Excalidraw's own test fixture. The source revision is pinned so changes in the upstream test
data can be reviewed:

- [elementFixture.ts at b7de45e88111f5680ae4bb3c3f3541c7d3b279fe](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/b7de45e88111f5680ae4bb3c3f3541c7d3b279fe/packages/excalidraw/tests/fixtures/elementFixture.ts)
- [diagramFixture.ts at b7de45e88111f5680ae4bb3c3f3541c7d3b279fe](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/b7de45e88111f5680ae4bb3c3f3541c7d3b279fe/packages/excalidraw/tests/fixtures/diagramFixture.ts)

The other fixtures in this folder exercise the acceptance cases in `plan-fmt-02-excalidraw.md`.
